title: Accelerator Stock & Order Pulse Forecast
content:
Executive summary:
This sheet is a tactical pulse-view of accelerator inventory and near-term procurement across regions. Purpose: give on-call infrastructure, procurement, and SRE leads a single-pane weekly snapshot to make fast tradeoffs (commit to reserves, escalate vendor lanes, or trigger temporary burst from cloud partners).

Inventory table (snapshot, units):
Region, Accelerator, On-hand, Reserved (committed), Transit (units), ETA (days), Lead time (days), Vendor cohort, Avg burn (units/week), Days of cover (on-hand / burn), Safety buffer (days), Action required
us-west-2, H100-80GB, 42, 12, 60, 21, 35, Primary-USA, 28, 1.5, 14, Schedule expedite with vendor A, split arrival by AZ
us-east-1, A100-80GB, 110, 40, 10, 9, 28, Secondary-USA, 65, 1.7, 21, Hold allocation for Dedicated pools; no rush
eu-west-1, H100-80GB, 18, 6, 24, 18, 40, EU-Distributor, 22, 0.8, 10, Confirm customs clearance ETA; prepare fallback from eu-central
apac-sg, L40S-32GB, 30, 8, 0, -, 45, APAC-Direct, 12, 2.5, 30, Consider small local order to smooth next quarter
apac-tokyo, H100-80GB, 6, 3, 18, 16, 42, APAC-Distributor, 10, 0.6, 12, High risk: <10 units, engage regional sales for priority lane
ca-central-1, A10G, 80, 10, 0, -, 20, Secondary-Resale, 35, 2.3, 14, Good buffer; consider swapping capacity to us-west if needed

Notes on table: days-of-cover less than 2 flagged as high-risk. Transit ETAs are vendor-provided and assume customs windows intact. Lead times reflect average from PO date to rack-ready in region.

Procurement pipeline (next 90 days):
- Tranche Alpha (weeks 1-4): vendor A firm order for 120 H100-equivalents (mix H100/compatible L40S) with staggered shipping windows (week2, week4). Purpose: replace 10% of retiring fleet and shore up hosted capacity. Contingency lane: cloud burst agreement (AWS spare pool) for 6 weeks.
- Tranche Beta (weeks 6-10): smaller opportunistic buy (50 units A100 or equivalent) conditional on price < $xxk/unit and freight window < 21 days. Fallthrough: convert to reserve for Dedicated customers.
- Tranche Gamma (weeks 10-14): Hold decision pending Q2 demand signal and quantization rollout results; target replenishment if utilization > 75% and spot prices > threshold.

Staging & logistics windows:
- Synchronize inbound shipments to at most 2 arrivals per region per month to reduce customs & racking bottlenecks.
- Maintain an inter-region transfer buffer (10% of on-hand) to enable emergency transfers within 7 days.
- For APAC, add 7 extra days for local testing and firmware validation.

Assumptions behind numbers:
- Burn rates are computed from trailing 8-week average request distribution (hosted + dedicated).
- Reserved units include Dedicated contracts + short-term customer hold (1 week granularity).
- Vendors quoted lead times exclude potential semiconductor slowdowns or geopolitical disruptions.
- Price sensitivity: if unit price moves > 12% vs quote, re-evaluate tranche Beta.

Risks & mitigations:
- Customs/港湾 congestion (EU/UK seasonal): mitigation: route via alternate EU hub + expedite lane at additional cost; hold 14-day safety buffer for eu-west shipments.
- Single-vendor concentration for H100: mitigation: qualify two APAC/EU distributors by EOM, keep at least one cross-shipment option.
- Firmware/regression risk on new L40S: mitigation: stage 10 units to staging clusters for stress tests before full scheduling.

Action items (owners and target dates):
- P0: Marco Alvarez -> get vendor A expedite confirmation for us-west tranche (target 2025-01-15).
- P1: Priya Khanna -> update reorder thresholds to 1.8x burn for Dedicated SKUs (target 2025-01-20).
- P1: Janelle Park -> open qualification PR to European distributor X (JIRA-INFR-4821) (target 2025-01-22).

Decision log highlights:
- 2024-12-05: Converted planned H100 buy to mixed H100/L40S after performance trials indicated comparable throughput for embedding-heavy workloads (reduced cost per token).
- 2025-01-03: Enabled cloud-burst fallback at negotiated 9% premium for critical accounts; triggers when regional utilization > 85% for 3 consecutive days.

Short-term scenarios to watch (dashboard signals):
- Sudden 20% increase in generative traffic localized to us-west -> trigger expedite lane + transfer 10% from ca-central.
- Failure of primary vendor cohort -> trigger 7-day emergency purchase from market-maker with 15% premium and notify sales.

Appendix: data sources and calibrations:
- Inventory counts pulled from internal fleet ledger (service: fleet-warehouse, snapshot: 2025-02-09).
- Burn rate derived from telemetry (prometheus:token-consumption-rate) aggregated by model-class.
- Cost inputs referenced in Procurement Pricing sheet (Confluence link above).

Footer: This is a working document (sheet view) intended for infra/ops/ procurement sync. For formal purchase orders and legal commitments, follow Procurement SOP and update the Fleet PO register.
